motion_and_interactions.principles: Subtle, fluid micro-interactions with ease-out physics. No heavy spinning or disorienting full-page flips.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: opacity: 0 to 1, y: 6 to 0 in 0.25s ease-out
motion_and_interactions.drawer_sheets: slide in from bottom (mobile) or right (desktop) with 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion_and_interactions.payment_success_stamp: scale: 0.8 to 1 with spring bounce for the official 'SUDAH DIBAYAR' green badge
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap motion animations inside prefers-reduced-motion media query checks or fallback to instant rendering

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All normal text tokens maintain minimum 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Slate-900 (#0F172A) on White is 17.5:1, Teal-700 (#0F766E) on White is 7.2:1.
accessibility.form_accessibility: All inputs use explicit Shadcn Label components with matching htmlFor. Date pickers use custom calendar popover with keyboard navigation.
accessibility.interactive_targets: All mobile tap targets are at least 44x44px. Buttons have distinct hover, focus-visible:ring-2 ring-teal-500, and active:scale-95 feedback states.
accessibility.data_testids: Every button, tab, quick-login role card, payment trigger, attendance toggle, and filter input must include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & TONE: Maintain a soft, warm, modern, and professional SaaS atmosphere tailored for preschool administration in Malaysia. Avoid dark mode or childish arcade looks.

2. LANGUAGE: The entire interface must be in authentic Bahasa Malaysia with proper terminology (Murid, Ibu Bapa, Guru, Kehadiran, Yuran, Bil, Resit Rasmi, Pengumuman, Log Harian, etc.). All currency must display as 'RM XXX.XX' and dates in Malay month names (Jan, Feb, Mac, Apr, Mei, Jun, Jul, Ogo, Sep, Okt, Nov, Dis).

3. THREE ROLE EXPERIENCES: Implement a seamless role-switching mechanism (via the persistent top demo banner or /login quick-login buttons) allowing evaluation of: Pentadbir (Admin Desktop-First), Guru (Teacher Mobile-First), and Ibu Bapa (Parent Mobile-First).

4. LOCAL STORAGE PERSISTENCE: Use a rich mock data store in localStorage seeded with authentic Malaysian names (Cikgu Sarah, Puan Siti Nurhaliza, Muhammad Adam, Nur Aishah, etc.), pre-populated invoices, attendance records, and timeline activities, including a 'Reset Data Demo' button in Settings.

5. INTERACTIVE FLOWS: Implement the full simulated online payment modal with step-by-step progress and printable official receipt, as well as the quick one-tap attendance and daily log drawers for teachers.
6. CHARTS & SHADCN: Use Recharts for the attendance trend and finance breakdown. Use shadcn/ui base-nova components (@base-ui/react contract) with appropriate data-testid attributes throughout.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use generous Tailwind spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-5). Prevent cramped tables or crowded mobile cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans Variable for clean, geometric, high-legibility preschool management presentation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_ids: Every interactive trigger (role switch, tab change, modal submit, receipt print, attendance toggle) must include data-testid in kebab-case.
